node: Data-center power, thermal management, electrical equipment, and grid interconnection
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the underfollowed lane finds that the strongest US-listed discovery candidates are no longer tiny: the market has already rerated several data-center power and cooling suppliers. Still, Powell Industries, Modine Manufacturing, and IES Holdings remain useful second-order candidates because they map to switchgear, thermal systems, and scarce field-installation labor rather than GPUs or cloud software. Vertiv is retained only as a high-attention reference anchor for the node.
